latest_release.name: v2026.05.09
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Merge `master` into `develop` by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2960
* recipes: new `materialyoucolor` recipe by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2950
* Add support for display cutouts in manifest and add methods to retrieve data by @kuzeyron in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2969
* (`recipes/materialyoucolor`): update to 2.0.7 by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2975
* Arch type error when creating apk for project with setup.py by @pramodin in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2978
* :white_check_mark: Fix test_get_dep_names_of_package by @AndreMiras in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2979
* MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE by @cweilouis in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2983
* :white_check_mark: improve sh mocking reliability by @AndreMiras in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2980
* :white_check_mark: Fix broken sdl2 mixer test by @AndreMiras in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2987
* :loud_sound: Improve rebuild recipes logging & bump `pyzbar` version by @AndreMiras in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2986
* :fire: Remove unused Makefile variables by @AndreMiras in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2985
* libzmq: fix build by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2842
* recipes: new recipe `coincurve` by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2835
* Qt Bootstrap - Adapting to Qt 6.7 release by @shyamnathp in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2990
* (`recipes/materialyoucolor`): update to 2.0.9 by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2994
* recipes: Introduce `RustCompiledComponentsRecipe`, add `pydantic-core` and update `cryptography` by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/2962
* Fix mock assertion in ICU recipe by @s-t-e-v-e-n-k in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3003
* Sunset `apple-silicon-m1` self-hosted runner, as now is supported by Github Hosted runners via `macos-latest` tag. Use `macos-13` for runs on Intel macs by @misl6 in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3011
* recipe: introduce isolated builds, using `PyProjectRecipe` by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3007
* recipes: add new `pyreqwest_impersonate` recipe by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3016
* recipes: add new `uvloop` recipe by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3015
* pillow: update to `10.3.0` by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3022
* `ffpyplayer`: update to `4.5.1` by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3025
* `archs.py`: remove backslash logic by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3026
* `sqlalchemy`: update to `2.0.30` by @T-Dynamos in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3027
* ✨Fixed wrong spelling: depelopment -> development by @ByteJoseph in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3038
* recipes: add new `grpcio` recipe by @kengoon in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3023
* Grpcio recipe: Fix runtime error, cannot locate symbol "getservbyport_y" by @kengoon in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3043
* libsodium-recipe-update to url by @gonatienza in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3042
* Add ModernGL recipe by @emersonmx in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3045
* Fix broken quickstart link by @zenoengine in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3046
* :construction_worker: Publish to DockerHub by @AndreMiras in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3047
* :mute: Fix sh logs too verbose by @AndreMiras in https://github.com/kivy/python-for-android/pull/3048
* :arrow_up: Bump sh module to v2, refs #
